text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52636d

g.text: Text-only Gemma 4 E2B, unquantized BF16. All 10 fixed conditions. Zero training.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364b56

g.text: The joint MLP swap replaces 86,016 native channel values at one selector position across layers 0 through 13.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364b56

g.text: Same-rule donors reverse label mappings. Opposite-rule transfer changes the requested behavior; it is not a coding gain.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364b56

g.text: Sixteen prompts reuse four instruction/mapping strata with operand-name and policy pairs. They are not sixteen algorithms.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364b56

g.text: All 200 outputs and no-op/restoration guards passed audit. Individual neuron meanings and fresh transfer remain unresolved.
